# JetLearn

> > JetLearn is a leading online AI academy offering personalized 1:1 coding, robotics, and AI education for children ages 6-16 worldwide.

JetLearn provides comprehensive STEM education through live interactive classes in programming languages like Python and Scratch, game development platforms like Roblox, and AI-powered math tutoring. The platform emphasizes personalized learning with mastery-based approaches while supporting diverse learners including neurodiverse students and girls in tech through initiatives like JetGirls.

## Key Topics

- Coding Education
- Python Programming
- Scratch
- Roblox Game Development
- AI & Artificial Intelligence
- STEM Education
- Robotics
- 1-on-1 Tutoring
- Personalized Learning
- Ages 6-16
- Online Classes
- Game Development
- Problem-Solving Skills
- Tech Education for Kids
- Mastery Learning

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Python for Kids (Ages 6-16)](https://www.jetlearn.com/python-for-kids): Python for Kids program with live 1:1 classes, game development, robotics, and data science for ages 6-16.
- [Scratch Coding Classes for Kids (Ages 6-16)](https://www.jetlearn.com/scratch-for-kids): Scratch coding classes: Fun 1:1 lessons for kids to create animations and games with foundational skills.
- [Roblox for Kids (Ages 6-16)](https://www.jetlearn.com/roblox-for-kids): Roblox game development and 3D world design classes teaching coding logic and creative skills for ages 6-16.
- [Maths Mastery](https://www.jetlearn.com/fun-with-maths): AI-powered personalized math tutoring using mastery learning approach with data-driven progress tracking.
- [School of Life - Online Workshops for Kids (Ages 6-16)](https://www.jetlearn.com/school-of-life): School of Life: Online workshops blending creativity and technology for skill development ages 6-16.

## Social Impact & Inclusion Initiatives

- [Impact by JetLearn](https://www.jetlearn.com/impact): JetLearn social impact initiatives: Tech education for underserved communities and women empowerment.
- [JetGirls - A Story of Change](https://www.jetlearn.com/jetgirls): JetGirls initiative addressing gender gap in STEM education and empowering girls in tech.
- [NeuroDiverse page](https://www.jetlearn.com/neurodiverse): Neurodiverse learning program: Coding education for autism, ADHD with emotional safety and independence.
